p: as he shall be able to: That is, as much as he will.
according as his hand shall be: Meaning, as he will think good.
year of liberty: Which was at the Jubile, Le 25:9.
take of the people's inheritance by: But be content with that portion that God has assigned him, as in Eze 45:8.
to sanctify the people: That the people should not have to do with those things which belong to the Lord, and think it lawful for them to eat them.
